associations.rationale: The type computes the cardinality of the constructed index by the displayed three-term sum, but does not state irreducibility, completeness, or equality with the conjugacy-class count.
The type defines a family of GL₂ representations indexed by ConstructedIndex; it does not assert their simplicity, exhaustiveness, or the counting equality.
The type shows that isomorphic members of the constructed family have equal indices, supporting nonredundancy but not the entire counting-and-completeness claim.
The type proves each constructed family member is simple, covering irreducibility only and not the total count or completeness.
The type proves the arithmetic identity equating the three-term sum with q²−1, but does not connect it to conjugacy classes or classify all irreducible representations.

The type says every simple GL₂ representation is uniquely isomorphic to a member of the constructed family, giving completeness and uniqueness but not itself the family's simplicity or the count comparison.
The type computes the number of GL₂ conjugacy classes as q²−1 under the displayed hypotheses, but does not state the representation-family count, simplicity, or completeness.
